A '''Sector Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] formation. It consisted of six [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
